visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark wavy hair, wearing a black bikini, stands at the edge of a swimming pool. She is smiling and holding a pink and yellow inflatable swim ring. The setting is bright and sunny outdoors with a white modern building and a large beige umbrella in the background. (2) The camera angle remains static as the woman crouches down at the pool's edge, still clutching the swim ring. A person wearing a light pink hooded jacket and a black shoulder bag enters the left foreground, carrying a white bucket. (3) The person in the foreground throws a large splash of water from the bucket directly at the woman. She loses her balance, her arms fly up, and she falls backwards into the pool water. (4) The woman surfaces from the water, her hair and face completely wet, laughing. The camera pans slightly to follow her as she wipes water from her eyes and interacts with people off-camera while standing in the shallow end.
